Analysts and outlets tied the sell-off to a Democratic sweep in the midterm elections, which raised concerns about political resistance to AI infrastructure.
drivers: Broad chip sector sell-off on Thursday
Report of a $4.5 billion Taiwan plant pause
Political pushback on AI infrastructure after the Democratic sweep
Nasdaq correction amid AI trade meltdown
